stem: A network performance study measures the download speed (Mbps) for a sample of 30 subscribers. The sample mean is 153.5 Mbps with a sample standard deviation of 23.9 Mbps. Assuming the data are approximately normally distributed, estimate the true population mean and provide a 95% confidence interval.

ground_truth.answer: Population mean ≈ 153.5 Mbps. 95% CI = [144.6, 162.4]. Point estimate: 153.5 Mbps.

common_failure_modes: Using z-critical value instead of t-critical for small samples
Not reporting the confidence interval alongside the point estimate
